This is incredible. Voyager 1 is now one single light-day from Earth: 16.1 billion miles, after 49 years of travel.

Built with 1970s tech, still calling home. 
Patience is everything.

https://www.nasa.gov/news-release/nasas-voyager-1-makes-history-reaching-one-light-day-from-earth/
